A first-year student and the current student council president of the east tower, who is also Kazuha's childhood friend. She is from a prestigious European magician family, with her father working all around the world. Honoka uses flame magic and is one of the most talented users of her generation. Before being elected, Mao was the former next student council president.

A very energetic and bright girl who is always smiling like the sun itself. She loves being with people and meeting with new ones as well. She has a habit of yelling "C'est Super!" (lit. that's great! in French). Due to her prestigious background, Honoka is quite naive and often dreams about the "childish" kind of love - in other words, waiting for her own Prince Charming.

A first-year student who is the current student council president of the west tower and the principal's only daughter. Controlling light-type magic, Iris has the best potential and skill among the school, which is almost equal with her mother's. She came to Japan this spring in order to apply to a high school there, and she stays at the protagonist's home. She became the new student council president only because Sharifa and the other members thought it would be a good idea.

Though she is very hardworking in both school work and other chores, Iris is also extremely shy and has a hard time getting used to campus life. She does her best so she can be complimented more by her dear mother, whom she loves very much.
魔女学の世界的権威にして御久仁学園の学園長「マリア・ラインフェルト」の一人娘。この春、日本に留学してきた海外留学生で、母マリアを超える才能を持つ "光"の魔女。
極端な人見知りで引っ込み思案な性格が災いし、学園生活に溶け込めず一人静かに佇む月のような少女。消極的すぎる性格を自覚している一方、大好きなママが誇りに思える自分になるため、陰で努力する頑張り屋さん。
前生徒会長の「シャリファ・ルクサーナ」に強引に押しつけられ、新生徒会長に就任。一癖も二癖もある生徒会メンバーたちを相手に苦悩する毎日である。
ホームステイ先の東雲家でも「はわはわ」言いながら、家事などのお手伝いをけなげに頑張っている（本人的には）。

Being a gamer, she loves snacks and is always shown eating umeboshi in the student council room.

A third-year student and the former student council president of the east tower before Honoka was elected for the position. She is one of the best ice magic users within the academy.

Mao doesn't let small things worry her and talks in a calm way. Due to her mysterious personality, it is often to hard to guess what she's thinking about. Underneath her mysterious outlook, she has a very friendly personality and takes care of her peers. Despite all this, she prefers using brute force when she's faced with a problem.

あまり感情のこもらない、ぽつぽつとしたしゃべり方をする無口で無表情な堅氷のような少女。そんなミステリアスな雰囲気の一方で、強引で派手なやり方を好むダイナミックさも兼ね備える。

A first-year student and the current student council secretary of the west tower. A foreign exchange student from USA, her power is to turn her magic into iron. However, her goal is to become a better martial artist instead of a magician.

She looks down on weaker opponents and is always looking for stronger ones, also likes to run away from her responsibilities, which annoys the other members of the student council. Melissa is always aiming for a higher position: for example, when she was not chosen to be the new president by Sharifa, she got really mad for getting to be in such a "low position". Gets most of her energy from hot and corn dogs.

A first-year student and the student council accounting manager of the west tower. Nicknamed Tanya, she controls darkness magic and came as a foreign exchange student because she has completely fallen in love with Japan's otaku culture. She is also the Russian representative of the game "Witch's Garden", for which she won the worldwide tournament last year. Due to this, she works as a pro game designer in Okakae, the game company behind the game.

A gloomy girl who often pretends to be sleeping and likes spending her time in the dark. She also likes being alone, and is almost always shown doing nothing but playing on her portable device. She was appointed and recommended as the accounting manager by Sharifa herself.

A third-year student, the former student council president of west tower before Iris and a foreign exchange student from Malaysia. Her magic type is considered very rare in the magic world: she is able to use her magic to create all kinds of creatures. Her potential is so high that she is considered a genius in the magicians' world.

An extremely popular girl who however, wears her school uniform in a very revealing way and is almost always talking dirty. She likes messing around with boys and dancing around as well. She has high expectations for Iris because of the crushing defeat which made her see Mao as her rival, and wants to have revenge on her.
西塔生徒会の前生徒会長。
マレーシアからやってきた留学生で"花"の魔女。愛称はシャリー。自らの魔力を植物の形を借りて具現化するという世界的にも希有な魔法で、具現化した植物は様々な特性を持つ。
特異な魔法を駆使する学園屈指の天才魔女として誰もが一目置く存在の彼女。しかし、制服をエロく着崩すわ、口を開けばエロいことを言うわ、存在そのものがエロいわで模範生とは言いがたい妖花のような少女。
何事にも面白半分であまり本気を見せない彼女だが、生徒会長として臨んだ昨年の魔法生徒会大戦では惨敗。それ以降、「氷室舞生」をライバル視しており、舞生の前ではいつもの余裕がないムキになった姿を見せる。
稀代の才能を持つ「アイリス・ラインフェルト」を新しい会長に担ぎ、自身は副会長として昨年のリベンジに燃える。
西塔生徒会の前生徒会長。
マレーシアからやってきた留学生で 花の魔女。 愛称はシャリー。
自らの魔力を植物の形を借りて具現化するという、世界的にも希有な魔法を使う。
特異な魔法を駆使する学園屈指の天才魔女として、誰もが一目置く存在の彼女。
しかし制服をエロく着崩すわ、口を開けばエロいことを言うわ、
存在そのものがエロいわで、模範生とは言いがたい妖花のような少女。
会長として臨んだ昨年の大戦で舞生に惨敗してから、舞生をライバル視している。
普段はあまり本気を見せない彼女だが、舞生の前ではムキになった姿を見せることも。
稀代の才能を持つアイリスを会長に担ぎ、自身は副会長としてリベンジに燃える。
「フフフ♪　わたしが欲しければ正々堂々口説きに来なさい、蒼ちゃん」

The protagonist who is the only male possessing magic abilities in the world. Despite this fact, he is not able to control his magic well and can only use a very small portion of it. In order to train his magic and because the principal took an interest in him, Aoi is transferred to Mikuni Academy for Witches.

Has above average grades and excellent reflexes, and is an all-around person in housework. However, he has a tad dull and serious personality but at times is pretty calm. Aoi has a strong will and does no give up easily despite his low magic potential.
